attributes.action: Ban parties from punishing MPs who vote with their constituents
attributes.additional_details:
The whipping system is undemocratic. MPs are elected by constituents, not parties. We ask the Government to legislate that:
-It becomes illegal for any party to remove the whip, deselect, or punish an MP who votes in line with the clearly expressed views of a majority of their constituents (e.g. local poll or petition signed by 10% of voters). 
-Every MP must publicly record before each vote how their decision relates to their constituents’ interests.
It’s time to put voters before party bosses.
attributes.background: Make it illegal for political parties to punish MPs for voting in line with their constituents

rejection.details: We don't quiet know what you specifically want to happen: are there to be local polls or petitions in a constituency only after an MP is disciplined?  what does punish mean in this context (other than deselect or remove the whip)?
